phases.title: Phase 1 — Core Arcade Loop
phases.goal: Build a playable warehouse sorting loop with scoring and progression.
phases.desc: Implemented modular architecture, event-driven UI, dynamic difficulty, combo systems, and Meta Progression (upgrades).

phases.title: Phase 2 — Content Expansion
phases.goal: Add variety to the warehouse shifts.
phases.desc: More warehouse events, additional package types, and multiple levels to test sorting skills.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Polish & Release Prep
phases.desc: Better visual polish, expanded sound effects, main menu improvements, and performance balancing.
